info.title: Support Bridge Operator API
info.description: Single-operator internal prototype for linked GitHub Issues and Zendesk Tickets. Local mode is the default. All /api operations require a process-configured bearer token of at least 32 non-whitespace characters. Never expose the built-in PHP development server publicly. No remote base URL, credentials, mode or state path can be supplied through this API. GET /metrics uses a separate strong read-only scrape token; tokens must be different. Deterministic governance policy escalation-state-v1 allows title-only updates for explicitly linked records and requires an operator attestation for any planned outbound open/closed transition before any effects of that plan. Never rely on AI in compliance: AI output cannot authorize an effect, override policy, or certify compliance. The shared operator credential does not prove a human identity or separation of duties. Explicit engineering-tag intake can create one open GitHub issue and link it to its Zendesk origin. This creation opt-in does not grant resolution approval or a conflicting-source decision. Explicitly enabled GitHub issue-comment delivery appends internal Zendesk notes only. It preserves source snapshots and unknown-outcome evidence, never approves a state plan, and pauses new notes while reconciliation work is pending. New engineering issues include a one-time copy of the initial Zendesk description and an explicit Zendesk ticket link; later replies and description edits do not rewrite their bodies.

servers.description: Same origin; localhost for the demonstration.

get.summary: Liveness only; does not read SQLite or call a provider.
List linked pair metadata (without title snapshots).

post.summary: Opt two existing records into reconciliation.

201.description: Link created. No vendor API is called.

Location.description: Inspection URL of the new link.

post.description: IDs are strings. Links must be unique on both sides. This creates no remote records. Repeating the same POST returns 409; do not blindly replay mutations.

get.summary: Inspect snapshots, pending intent, governance evidence, approval and recent audit.

200.description: Operator-only data; may include sensitive ticket titles.

get.summary: Read local business counts and diagnostic metric-registry availability.

200.description: Local state counts and telemetry registry availability; not proof of scrape health.
Sweep completed. Counts may include retry/conflict/dead/awaiting_approval outcomes that need operator attention.

post.description: Reads/writes the configured provider accounts in live mode. Polling remains the repair path. A second worker receives 409. The sweep is synchronous and may outlive a client timeout: inspect state before retrying. No client idempotency key or async queue is implemented. A newly planned outbound state transition is persisted as awaiting_approval with no remote writes. Already pending approvals are skipped; inspect pair/status counts for the outstanding queue.

post.summary: Choose one fresh observed side for a quarantined pair.

200.description: Source choice queued; the next sweep still enforces the state-change approval gate.

post.description: Reads both providers but performs no remote write. Both canonical fields and versions must still match the saved conflict snapshot. A 409 may refresh conflict evidence; inspect again before choosing. The choice selects the entire source record. A source choice does not authorize a consequential state transition; the next sweep may enter awaiting_approval.

post.summary: Requeue retry/dead work after its cause is fixed.
post.description: Cannot bypass conflict review. Resetting the retry budget does not discard the durable write plan. Does not grant approval or bypass awaiting_approval; governance is rechecked before effects.

get.summary: Read the locally vendored Swagger UI reference.

200.description: Swagger UI HTML. Read-only: Try it out and the remote validator are disabled.
OpenAPI JSON, served locally without account data.

get.summary: Scrape aggregate and complete linked-pair metrics using the separate read-only token.

200.description: Prometheus text format 0.0.4, newline terminated. Counters/histograms persist separately; business aggregates and complete linked-pair gauges come from one read-only SQLite snapshot. Every mapping has seven gauges using validated numeric GitHub issue/Zendesk ticket labels; no internal pair keys, titles, note text or approval evidence. Numeric IDs are monitoring data and series grow seven per link. Baseline-only resolution, unknown states and zero never-verified timestamps remain explicit. Retired demo-case series are not backfilled. No provider reads, reconciliation, approval or business writes occur.

get.description: Read-only authenticated Prometheus exposition. Aggregate gauges and all linked-pair metadata share one local read transaction. Dynamic pair gauges expose numeric github_issue and (on status only) zendesk_ticket labels, with seven series per link plus a stored total. Internal pair keys, titles, descriptions, comments, errors and approval evidence are excluded. Scraping never contacts providers or executes commands. The old fixed demonstration-case families are retired; retained historical samples are not rewritten.

post.summary: Attest to review of an exact pending state-change plan.

200.description: Approval recorded; execution deferred until a subsequent sweep.

post.description: Requires awaiting_approval and the plan_hash shown by inspection. Reads both records under the canonical worker lock and rejects stale fields or versions with 409. Records the policy version, plan hash, rationale and shared-operator principal; the next sync applies the plan only after governance and recovery checks. Performs no remote write. Approval is an operator attestation, not verified human identity or legal/regulatory compliance. AI-generated reasons have no authorization effect without this explicit command; do not grant this capability to an autonomous agent. Repeated approvals return 409; inspect state after any client timeout.

plan_hash.description: Exact current governance.plan_hash from authenticated inspection. This is an evidence identifier, not a credential.

reason.description: UTF-8 operator rationale; trim-nonempty and at most 500 bytes (runtime enforces bytes). Avoid sensitive content; stored in local audit.

example.reason: Reviewed the linked escalation and confirmed that this resolution state should propagate.

post.summary: Discover explicitly tagged Zendesk tickets and create/link their engineering issues.

200.description: Bounded intake completed; waiting work can remain.

post.description: Explicitly enabled live operation. Discovers one bounded ticket-list page, prepares durable creation intents, and processes at most five prepared plus five recovery intents. Only open tickets retaining the configured engineering tag can initiate creation. The marker and source snapshot are durable before POST. Unknown creation outcomes are searched by their exact marker; absence never causes another POST. Counts describe this invocation; GET /api/escalations and metrics describe the stored queue. No approval, conflict source selection or reconciliation is performed by this operation. Existing linked records are preserved. Before its first POST, a fresh supported initial description (at most 30000 UTF-8 bytes) is saved with the snapshot and copied as literal text into the issue body. Existing attempted snapshots remain unchanged and existing bodies are not automatically backfilled.

get.summary: Read durable engineering-escalation intents without contacting providers.
get.description: Operator-only evidence, including source snapshots and creation correlation markers. No vendor requests or writes.

post.summary: Deliver linked GitHub issue comments as internal Zendesk notes.

200.description: Bounded pass completed; unavailable or waiting work can remain.

post.description: Explicitly enabled live command. Scans bounded issue-comment histories for existing links, saves first-observed snapshots, and processes up to five recovery and five pending deliveries. Existing comments are included once; later edits/deletion do not rewrite notes. New appends require a synced pair without pending plan/conflict/approval and matching fresh canonical fields. An attempted append is never blindly repeated: recovery searches a durable marker and requires public=false. No request-supplied note, public flag, identity, provider URL, source choice or approval is accepted. Counts describe this pass, not the complete ledger.

get.summary: Read comment delivery and discovery evidence without provider requests.
get.description: Operator-only sensitive note snapshots and delivery markers. Items and streams are independently paged using the same limit/offset; total and stream_total describe each collection. Queries never discover, append or approve anything.

get.summary: Read complete linked-pair context for the Grafana table.
get.description: Read-only complete business-store snapshot, without provider requests, reconciliation, approval or business writes. Uses the same read-only monitoring bearer as /metrics, which now permits reading baseline subjects and configured vendor URLs here; it cannot access operator commands. Subjects/URLs never enter Prometheus labels. Grafana viewers can read every linked baseline subject through this datasource. Unknown subjects and local-fixture URLs are null. No pagination or request parameters; capacity is unmeasured.

200.description: Complete current linked-pair table context, not continuous provider freshness.

subject.description: Last verified baseline title, at most 500 UTF-8 bytes; null means no verified subject. Never selected from an unapproved target or fetched during this query.

zendesk_url.description: Fixed HTTPS tenant agent-ticket URL from trusted deployment identity; null for local fixtures.

github_url.description: Fixed HTTPS configured-repository issue URL; null for local fixtures.

bearerAuth.description: BRIDGE_API_TOKEN; one operator identity, no per-user roles.

metricsBearer.description: Separate strong read-only monitoring credential for Prometheus /metrics and the Grafana /monitoring/pairs context view. The latter includes baseline subjects and configured record URLs. Cannot access operator endpoints.

title.description: Nonempty, at most 500 UTF-8 bytes (the runtime enforces bytes).

next_run.description: Unix seconds; 0 means no scheduled retry.
Unix seconds; 0 means no scheduled retry.

details.description: JSON-encoded metadata, not raw vendor data.

reason.description: UTF-8 rationale, at most 500 bytes; local operator attestation, not a compliance decision.

requires_approval.description: True when the persisted plan contains any outbound open/closed transition.

approved.description: Persisted attestation matches this exact plan and current policy; no assertion of verified human identity.

initial_description.description: Optional sensitive first ticket description. The runtime enforces 30000 UTF-8 bytes; metadata-only and legacy attempted snapshots omit this field. Known empty descriptions use an empty string.

held.description: Durable internal-only evidence hold; no further appends are allowed.

note.description: Sensitive immutable first-observed comment, source attribution and marker.

Error400.description: Malformed JSON or a non-object body.

Error404.description: Route or linked pair not found.

Error409.description: Duplicate link, invalid state, stale source choice or approval, concurrent update or worker busy.

Error422.description: Fields, types, query values or operation values do not match the contract.

Error500.description: Unexpected storage or internal error; no raw exception data is exposed.

Error502.description: A permanent provider request failure prevented the operator command.

Error503.description: API token/service configuration is missing, or a transient provider failure occurred.
